text: The TLAPS image fetches the pinned tlapm tarball from a release of Invariant's own, tlapm-1.6.0-pre-eef4b65 on gitdek/invariant, refining D-0229 and D-0269 (#387). The asset is an unmodified copy of tlaplus/tlapm's 1.6.0-pre x86_64 Linux asset at eef4b65, with the same SHA-256 pin. Upstream's rolling release replaced that asset twice on 2026-11-01, and each time the pinned image had nothing to build from, so the gate failed on every change until the pin moved. @gitdek approved publishing the copy. tlapm is BSD-2-Clause, and the tarball carries its LICENSE. Moving to a newer tlapm stays a decision: validate the build, then mirror it under a release named for its tlapm release and commit.
